How it works

From first call to finished.

Step 1

Pick the finish

See swatches of the 3M 2080 and Avery SW900 ranges on your vehicle in daylight.

Step 2

Inspect & prep

We check the paint (it must be factory or a fully cured professional repaint), then decontaminate every panel.

Step 3

Disassemble & wrap

Handles, lights and trim come off where needed so the film tucks behind edges instead of being cut on the panel.

Step 4

Post-heat & inspect

Edges and recesses are post-heated to lock the film, then we inspect the whole vehicle with you.

Do you serve Aurora?
Yes. From Aurora it’s usually 25–35 minutes south via Highway 404, Highway 400, Yonge Street or Bathurst Street to our shop. Everything is done at our shop at 50 Viceroy Rd, Unit 22–23, Vaughan, and we serve all of York Region.
How much is a colour change wrap in Aurora?
Full colour changes start at $2,800 for a car, $3,400 for an SUV and $3,200 for a pickup, before HST. Matte and satin finishes cost a little more than gloss, and door jambs are quoted as an add-on.
Can I take it through a car wash?
Touchless washes are fine. Brush washes will eventually scuff the film, especially matte and satin — hand washing is best.
Are door jambs included?
Not by default. If you want the new colour to show with the doors open, we quote jambs as extra labour.
Can you wrap over a repaint?
Only a fully cured, professionally applied repaint. Peeling or failing clear coat can’t be wrapped, because the film can pull it off on removal.
